levels.surface: علي بن الحسين العلوي بن علي بن عمر بن علي بن الحسين بن علي بن أبي طالب

notes: «عن جده علي بن مهزيار» and «عن أخيه موسى» are one link each (rule 7): the kinship word is dropped and the name stands. The bare «أبيه» and the final «جده» are relations; the text does not name the last one, so nothing is completed.
«أبي علي بن الحسين» in the saying is the subject of the act described, not a speaker, so he is not a link. The blessings (ع) and (ص) are not part of any surface.
